# AI Native

> AI Native is the AI workforce firm for U.S. small and medium-sized businesses. It designs, installs, trains, and manages a complete AI agent workforce for every worker in every department — a Chief of Staff agent for every worker and agents for sales, customer service, bookkeeping, marketing, operations, HR, and IT — done for you, reported in the business's own numbers. Its model has four stages: the Evaluation, the Install, Management, and the Report. It serves businesses that serve people in person, sell products to people, serve other businesses, and supply other businesses, from one-person operations to companies of 500.

AI Native™ is a trademark. Pronounced "A-I Native". Website: https://ainative.ai. Contact: sales@ainative.ai, 602-680-8011. Serves the United States only; does not serve enterprises.

## What AI Native does
- Designs, installs, trains, and manages a complete AI agent workforce for every worker in every department of a small or medium-sized business (1–500 employees), done for you.
- Agents: a Chief of Staff agent for every worker; Sales, Customer Service (chat, email, voice), Bookkeeping, Marketing, Operations, HR, and IT Helpdesk agents — examples; the workforce covers every department a business has.
- Tools: the tools a business keeps, the tools AI Native brings (website chat, a scheduling calendar, a bookkeeping system, a customer-service inbox — agent-ready, licensed on the client's behalf, set up and taught), and the tools AI Native makes.
- Four stages: the Evaluation (led by a senior leader who has run a business like the client's), the Install (tools first, then agents; staff trained; nothing installed until the staff can run it), Management (ongoing), the Report (work completed, hours returned, performance — measured or labelled a target).
- Every AI Native agent identifies itself as an AI agent in its first sentence and hands to a person when asked.
- Tagline: "Your business, AI Native." Category: the AI workforce firm. Outcome: the client becomes an AI Native company.
